Facilitator Guide

Session 1: Welcome to Your New Job & Understanding the Platform

A 90-minute onboarding session that takes new Benefits Administrators from first login to their first live Benefit Master build — anchored in the Maple North Benefits Group workplace simulation used across the full onboarding series.

Duration90 minutes
FormatFacilitator demo + concept + one full hands-on build
AudienceNew Benefits Administrators
PrerequisiteNone — first session
PlatformCompany Admin Platform
01

Design Brief

Session Promise

By the end of Session 1, the learner can navigate the platform, explain how benefits administration is organized, and has built their first Benefit Master entry.

Learning Objectives

  • Log in, select a plan, and navigate every main module from the dashboard.
  • Find help, search for a member or employer, and manage personal account settings.
  • Describe what a plan is and what a Super User can do that a standard Administrator cannot.
  • Explain the TPA / Employer / Member / Carrier / Broker relationship.
  • Explain what a benefit is, name the four benefit types, and explain why a Benefit Master must exist before a Benefit Plan.
  • Create one Benefit Master entry, correctly, from a simple specification.

Materials & Prep

Sandbox/UAT credentials distributed in advance; dashboard diagram handout for no-sandbox fallback; one simple Benefit Master specification per learner or pair; Core Setup Generator available as a fallback spec source.

Instructional Approach

Live facilitator demo for navigation, concept teaching for the benefit model, then one full hands-on build (Project Beaver, Part 1) that carries directly into Session 2.

02

Session Run-of-Show

Grouping is deliberately varied across the 90 minutes — group instruction to build shared vocabulary, facilitator-led demo before any hands-on step, and individual/pair practice to make the build real.
